63 

When my voice fell silent, an extreme			weakness forced me to stop in the centre of the room and look around for something			to lean on. While talking, I had probably wandered between the window and the now			empty bed, which still held the imprint of Joyce's body. She too had stood up,			and was staring at me from a distance so unfathomable that for a moment it made me			think: I've lost her. But after that split second of dismay, the warmth of her			cheek on mine pulls me back from that staggering distance. 

'I can't embrace you,			Modesta.' 

Perhaps she can't embrace me			because her wrists still hurt? But I can rest my palms on her soft shoulders, her			gently arched back, and fold my arms tightly around her, to ensure that I'll			never lose her. 

'Unfortunately people lose each			other, bambina ! Life separates even those who are most alike. At times we			are torn apart, déchirés , even from ourselves … You will send me			away, Modesta.' 

'Why do you say that, Joyce?			Why?' 

'When you know …' 

'But I trust you now. I proved it			to you.' 

'Have you heard anything from the			comrades?' 

This reference to the comrades irritates			me. I told her everything about me. Why doesn't she do the same? She does all			she can to see that I always learn things from others, from the outside. Why? Why not tell her what comrade Cianca			ordered me to do? This time he came to see me not just to collect his usual			money: 

'You see, Modesta, in Signora Joyce's dossier there's no				mention of weakness or fainting of any kind. She's described as a woman of				extraordinary courage and strength. zh:
63

当我的声音沉寂下来，一阵极度的虚弱迫使我停在房间中央，四顾寻找可以倚靠的东西。说话时，我大概一直在窗与如今已空的床之间徘徊——床上仍留着乔伊斯身体的印痕。她也站了起来，从一种深不可测的距离凝视着我，那一瞬间让我以为：我失去她了。但在那片刻的惊惶之后，她面颊的温热贴上了我的脸，将我从那令人眩晕的遥远中拉了回来。

「我不能拥抱你，莫德斯塔。」

也许她不能拥抱我，是因为手腕仍痛？但我可以将掌心覆在她柔软的双肩上，贴上她微微弓起的背脊，再紧紧合拢双臂环绕着她——以确保我永不会失去她。

「不幸的是，人与人终会离散，小宝贝！生活令最相似的人也彼此分离。有时我们被撕裂，从自身中被撕开……你会送我走的，莫德斯塔。」

「你为什么这样说，乔伊斯？为什么？」

「等你知道以后……」

「但我现在信任你。我已经向你证明了。」

「同志们有什么消息吗？」

这提到同志们的话让我恼怒。我把我的一切都告诉了她。她为什么不做同样的事？她千方百计确保我总从别人那里、从外部了解到她的事。为什么？为什么不告诉她的同志钱卡命令我做什么？这次他来找我，不只是来取他往常那笔钱：

「你看，莫德斯塔，在乔伊斯夫人的档案里，没有任何关于虚弱或昏厥的记录。她被描述为一个具有非凡勇气和力量的女性。她为事业付出了多少努力，令人敬佩。我们统计过，她似乎在监狱里待了不少时间，这里一点，那里一点。如果她试图……
